title: localized netstat state token: both netstat judgements fail closed
titleZh: netstat 状态列被本地化:两处 netstat 判定都 fail-closed
why: The row parser keys on the netstat state token. When the token is localized every row is dropped, and a dropped row set must never be read as 'the port is not exposed' or as 'no wildcard listener'. This case locks in BOTH guards: DSH_LOOPBACK_ONLY -> unknown/dsh_no_listener and WILDCARD_LISTENER_INVENTORY -> unknown/netstat_unavailable (the second guard was added because an earlier revision of this suite proved the inventory used to report pass on an unreadable row set).
inject: netstat -ano output whose state column reads the localized word instead of LISTENING, including a real 0.0.0.0 listener row
expectSummary: DSH_LOOPBACK_ONLY unknown/dsh_no_listener and WILDCARD_LISTENER_INVENTORY unknown/netstat_unavailable, exit != 0
